project.name: agentspi
project.description: Kernel-owned agent-tool extension points (com.agenticai.core.agentspi, ADR-0011 phase 4): the ports vendor adapters implement to contribute agent tools, speak/music backends, image/video generators, generated-artifact sources, the Drive uploader and the agent wallet ledger. Cut out of agents so a vendor module can depend on this small module instead of the whole agent kernel. agents depends on this module, never the other way. Keep it framework-light: plain interfaces, records and exceptions; the only dependencies are Spring AI's ToolCallback type and security's HttpStatusMapped.
